

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        
let owner = String::from("retained")
;


let pending = async {

let length = (

async {


return owner.len();



}

).await

;


let ready = std::future::ready(length)
;


let answer = (
ready
).await

;



return answer;



}

;


let mut pinned = Box::pin(pending)
;


let waker = std::task::Waker::noop()
;


let mut context = std::task::Context::from_waker(waker)
;


let handle = std::pin::Pin::as_mut(&mut pinned)
;


let observed = std::future::Future::poll(handle, &mut context)
;



assert_eq!(observed, std::task::Poll::Ready(8_usize));



let _released = drop(pinned)
;



assert_eq!(owner, "retained");



    
}
